entities.summary: Bernhardt "Ben" Klassen was an American white supremacist politician who founded the Creativity new religious movement when he published his book Nature's Eternal Religion in 1973. Klassen was openly racist, antisemitic and anti-Christian and first popularized the term "Racial Holy War" within the White Power movement.
